verdict.rationale: A cloud platform with AI services could plausibly let users attach external MCP servers as tool sources, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents Azure acting as an MCP client. The only MCP evidence (azure-probe-4) is an official MCP server, which is the opposite role and belongs to a different story. Azure Copilot generating Terraform is an adjacent feature and does not show Azure consuming tools from external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
